name: Infeed belt conveyor
description: Carries raw material from the receiving bay to the press line at a controlled rate.

name: Cooling water system
description: Closed-loop system that removes heat from the hydraulic press and the air compressor.

name: Cooling water pump A (duty)
description: Circulates cooling water through the closed loop. Normally the running pump.

name: Cooling water pump B (standby)
description: Identical standby pump that takes over automatically when pump A trips or loop pressure falls.

name: Plate heat exchanger
description: Transfers heat from the closed cooling loop to the site cooling tower circuit.

name: Rotary screw air compressor
description: Supplies 7 bar instrument and plant air to the whole factory.

name: Hydraulic press
description: 250 tonne press that forms the product. Main production machine of line 1.

name: Robot palletiser
description: Stacks finished product on pallets at the end of line 1.
